title: The pup at ten, on the seawall
logline: The pup up on the seawall itself, ten, where the crow sits, looking at the bay. Three legs on a wall. The man's hand at the edge, not helping.

panels.composition: A small three-legged dog standing up on top of a seawall looking at the bay, a man's hand at the frame's edge held back not helping, the crow farther along the wall.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small three-legged dog standing on top of a seawall looking out at a bay with a man's hand held back at the frame's edge not helping and a crow farther along the wall, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
